Gstarsoft (Suzhou Gstarsoft Co., Ltd.)

DWG-centric CAD vendor · outbound links only

Gstarsoft publishes the GstarCAD family, vertical applications (Architecture, Mechanical), point-cloud, BIM (GstarBIM), lightweight house design (Houseplan), cloud collaboration (GstarCAD 365), and the DWG FastView viewer line. Public English material is anchored on gstarcad.net; downloadable PDF manuals are centralized under Support → Help. LearnCAD summarizes entry points—we do not mirror OEM PDFs (legal).

Official entry points

  • Marketing & product hub: gstarcad.net
  • Manuals & user guides (PDF lists by product/version): gstarcad.net/support/help
  • Support email (shown on vendor site): support@gstarcad.net · sales: sales@gstarcad.net
  • DWG FastView (cloud/mobile/Windows viewers): en.dwgfastview.com

How we source terms & FAQ

The glossary layer adds plain-language stubs aligned to headings you will see inside Gstarsoft PDF manuals (installation, SNAP/GRID, xref, BOM, BIM export, viewer markup, Linux notes, etc.). Whenever the official wording matters, defer to the PDF for your build/language. If you downloaded manuals locally for offline authoring, cite file name + version in editorial notes—not full reproduction.
